timestamp_ordering.method: reordercap; timestamp sort only, no timestamp adjustment

clock_correction.method: SSH timestamp brackets before/after; minimum RTT samples; endpoint drift included
clock_correction.assumption: Clock offset remains inside the measured endpoint envelope during the run; reject clock steps.

capture_drops: consult tshark.stderr.txt; not assumed zero when unavailable
interpretation: Scheduled workload classes; elapsed response times describe acquisition and do not establish a DoS effect or classifier performance.
